title: Sea Room
blurb: A virtual pet in a long room by the ocean. Turn your phone and the room turns with you, gliding around to each side, while Sprout, a soft green pup with a chocolate Lab's heart, rolls across the floor to say hi.
controls: Turn the phone to change the view (or the ⟲ ⟳ buttons / arrow keys); tap the floor to throw the ball; tap or rub the pup to pet; Feed and Nap buttons
